metadata.case_name: SUNG FUK WAH v. LAM WAI LEUK AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: aluminium window frame installer (odd job basis)
plaintiff.occupation_after: van driver for a transportation company (odd job); substitute taxi driver 4 to 5 days each month

injuries.description: Amputation of the top of the right ring finger below the first joint
source: the machine amputated the top of the Plaintiff's right ring finger below the first joint of the finger
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: Mild cut wound to the right middle finger
source: caused a mild cut wound to his right middle finger
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of finger or thumb

manifestations.description: Difficulty in grasping small objects, likes coins, with his right hand (his preferred hand)
Numbness and pain from his amputated finger especially when the weather changes
Can no longer take part in table tennis (previous recreational activity)

treatments_received: initial treatment at a nearby government clinic
transfer by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital
attempted anastomosis of the detached part of his right ring finger (attempt failed)
operation to amputate the finger at the distal interphalangeal joint
surgery for removal of remnant nail on right ring finger

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from the amputation of the tip of the right ring finger and related symptoms

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer take part in table tennis, which he previously enjoyed
